thread:
mira: Quick follow-up from the PM  shortened action list below. We observed a recurring eviction+tail-latency pattern across three nights. Need owners, JIRA links, and RACI by EOD.

mira: Actions (condensed):
1) autoscaler pre-warm + connection drain (reduce cold-start spikes)
2) distributed health-check backoff + random jitter (prevent thundering)
3) eviction monitoring dashboard + night-threshold alert + nightly anomaly detector (track recurrence over 90d)
4) deterministic synthetic prompt set + nightly quality/latency job (fail on regressions)
5) update runbook: explicit handoff + reopen flow + escalation SLAs

mira: We need explicit R/A/C/I for each and a backup owner. I'll run weekly check-ins until closed.

dan: I'll take 1 and 3. Creating tickets now.
dan: INF-5010 created for pre-warm/drain, ETA 2026-04-08. INF-5011 created for eviction dashboard + detector, ETA 2026-03-31.

priya: I'll own 2, 4, and runbook updates (split into INF-5012 and INF-5013). ETAs: 2026-04-05 (health-checks), 2026-04-14 (synthetic), 2026-04-16 (runbook).

sre-bot: Postmortem doc updated: https://docs.redwood/internal/postmortems/gen-2026-03  follow-ups appended.

mira: RACI suggestions:
- 1: R=Dan, A=EngRuntime, C=SRE, I=PM/Support; backup=Priya.
- 2: R=Priya, A=EngInfra, C=SRE, I=EngRuntime; backup=Dan.
- 3: R=Dan, A=SRE, C=EngRuntime+Monitoring, I=PM; backup=Priya.
- 4: R=Priya, A=AppliedML, C=QA, I=PM; backup=Mira.
- 5: R=Mira, A=Oncall, C=Support+SRE, I=Exec; backup=Dan.

dan: Confirming RACI for 1 and 3. I'll add the team reviewers to the JIRA tickets.

priya: Confirming RACI for 2 and 4. INF-5012 and INF-5013 created and linked.

product-bot: Linked follow-ups doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/postmortems/followups-gen-2026-03  please paste JIRA links there.

mira: Please paste each JIRA link in the follow-ups doc and set the ticket due date + backup owner. I'll run a 15m weekly sync (Thursdays) until all closed.

dan: INF-5010: PR opened with pre-warm prototype and perf harness. Requesting EngRuntime review for kernel/quantization impact. Added backup owner @priya.

priya: INF-5012: health-check backoff table proposed, added stagger per-AZ offsets. Requesting SRE review.

priya: INF-5013: synthetic prompt draft pushed. Will include long-thread, multi-embed, and edge-case prompts. QA job hook done.

mira: For action 3 (eviction detector) let's ensure the alert ties to the nightly anomaly job and creates an auto-ticket if recurrence >2 in 30d. Dan please include recurrence tracking.

dan: Will do. INF-5011 updated with recurrence logic and auto-create rule.

mira: Scheduling a 20m handoff with owners + SRE + QA: Fri 11:00. If conflicts, reply here.

priya: Friday 11 works.

dan: Conflict at 11, can we do Fri 11:30?

mira: Moving to Fri 11:30. Invite sent.

sre-bot: Weekly follow-up check scheduled: Fri 11:30 recurring until tickets closed.

mira: Marking status = "remediations underway". If anyone needs to reassign, call it out here so I can update follow-ups doc. :white_check_mark:
